method: Built-in image_gen; realistic industrial-design refinement of previous catalog image, using simplified GLB only as a loose concept
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a convincing premium commercial studio PHOTOGRAPH of a real manufacturable complete home strength training station for an ecommerce catalog.
Input image is ONLY a loose concept of included equipment, approximate proportions, graphite/burnt-orange palette and warm studio composition. It reproduces a simplified 3D model too literally. Replace blocky toy-like fittings, perfectly flat discs and rigid slab upholstery with believable industrial design and real material detailing. Do NOT preserve exact source geometry.
Show ONE complete set: a sturdy four-post graphite steel power rack, one realistically adjustable incline bench positioned inside it, one Olympic barbell racked securely in J-cups with exactly two bumper plates per end (one orange inner and one black outer, balanced symmetric loading), and a compact cluster of spare orange and black bumper plates leaning safely together on the floor at image-left.
Rack: realistic square powder-coated steel tubing, clean evenly spaced adjustment holes, bolted plate gussets and crossmembers, flat stable base feet, upper pull-up bar, several empty plate storage pegs. Small restrained orange mounting plates and mechanically credible steel J-cups with black protective liners and locking pins—not oversized hollow orange cubes. Two adjustable horizontal pin-and-pipe safeties between front and rear uprights below the bar. Sound joints and subtle welds. Approximate whole set envelope 228 cm wide, 174 cm deep, 227 cm tall; preserve compact domestic footprint.
Barbell: straight knurled steel shaft, realistic shoulder collars and machined silver loading sleeves extending outside the plates, resting securely on both J-cups. Bumper discs with softly rounded rims, subtle recessed ring profiles, fine matte rubber grain and properly fitted stainless hubs, realistic consistent plate thickness and circular geometry. No chunky polygon edges or flat featureless discs.
Bench: a real commercial adjustable bench with separate ergonomic black vinyl seat and inclined backrest, rounded padded edges, fine stitched seams, credible foam thickness, steel base, actual ladder or indexed backrest adjustment mechanism, orange pivot details, rubber feet and small transport wheels. Make bench pad placement and orientation mechanically sensible and usable inside the rack. No reverse-facing slab or disconnected cushions.
Photographic quality: highly realistic powder coat, black rubber, textured vinyl upholstery, machined steel, restrained natural specular reflections, subtle manufacturing details. Warm off-white seamless studio floor/background, diffused softbox lighting, natural contact shadows. Flattering front three-quarter product angle, full set visible including top, base, both bar ends and spare plates with comfortable margins in a square frame. No people, extra racks, pulleys, cables, dumbbells, gym interior, logos, branding, text overlays, watermark or dimension labels. Avoid CGI, low-poly toy appearance, implausible intersections or floating parts.
review: User requested realistic product photography rather than exact reproduction of the simplified GLB. Final image retains four-post rack, loaded Olympic barbell with two plates per end, incline bench, safeties and spare plates. Refined details include lined steel J-cups, bolted gussets, realistic rubber plate rims and hubs, knurled bar, stitched padded bench and credible adjustment mechanism. Warm studio style and graphite/orange palette retained. GLB, top views and product dimensions unchanged. AI-generated product illustration, not a dimensional source or photograph of a manufactured product.
